quick_skim.title: Finding Change in Satellite Archives from Text: How to Combine Before-and-After Images Efficiently
quick_skim.abstract: Operational Earth observation increasingly calls for answering queries such as ``find the image pairs where a new building appeared.'' This means searching an archive of before-and-after (bi-temporal) satellite image pairs and ranking each pair by how well it matches a natural-language description of the change. The component that performs this match, the fusion module that combines the ``before'' and ``after'' views, must be run at query time across many candidate pairs, so its speed largely sets the cost of every search. We present a controlled comparison of how to build that module. Using one fixed image encoder (a frozen CLIP model) and one training recipe for all variants, we evaluate eight designs drawn from three families: attention, state-space models (Mamba), and learned compression (our Temporal Bottleneck Fusion, TBF). Each design is tested on two benchmarks (LEVIR-CC and Dubai-CC) with ten random seeds, so the reported differences are statistically grounded. We outline three findings: first, a training-free two-stage search (a cheap difference model that shortlists candidates, followed by attention fusion that re-ranks them) matches or exceeds full-fusion recall on LEVIR-CC while cutting query cost $10$-$15\times$, with comparable R@1/R@5 on Dubai-CC; second, the linear-time scan of Mamba, attractive on paper, gives no speed benefit at the patch counts typical of vision transformers ($L{=}196$): the scan is limited by memory bandwidth, whereas attention maps cleanly onto parallel hardware; and third, compressing the fused representation (TBF) reduces parameters by $2.3\times$ and latency by $1.6\times$ for a change-only BLEU-1 cost of $0.007$, although more aggressive compression quietly discards change-relevant detail that aggregate metrics fail to reveal.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Studies how to build the fusion module that combines before-and-after satellite images for natural-language change queries, comparing eight designs with a frozen CLIP encoder to maximize accuracy and speed.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 卫星影像档案检索需要根据自然语言描述在前后时相影像对中查找变化，其中融合模块需要在大量候选对上高效执行。本文固定CLIP编码器和训练设置，系统比较三类八种融合模块设计，评估其在检索精度与速度上的取舍。结果显示融合结构直接影响查询代价与匹配质量。该研究为双时相多模态遥感数据的融合提供实用设计指南。
